slug: 2026-03-04 Guinea Launches Biometric Birth Certificates in Sanoyah in Civil Registry Modernization Push

systems.system: Extraits de naissance biométriques (biometric birth certificates)
systems.owner: ONECI, with the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralization
systems.tiers: issued locally in Sanoyah commune from 2 March 2026, extending the service to a new commune; 2,000 certificates allocated to the first phase
enrolment in the home commune (Sanoyah) from 2 March 2026

note: The document describes the biometric birth certificate as issued to applicants who present a previous birth certificate, a supplementary court judgment or a RAVEC document, that is a document obtained on an existing record and not the registration of a birth when declared; so no civil fact. It calls the certificate the foundational document for the biometric national ID card.
